# Soundness Requirements Checklist: Loaded-Pointer Recovery

**Purpose**: Review whether HEX-C1-01 requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and release-ready across proof, conservative failure, identity, resource, and ownership boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-08-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Proof and Acceptance Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the positive proof preconditions defined as one current, complete, MustAlias-equivalent reaching store with exact compatible bytes and complete stored-pointer provenance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are deterministic positive outcomes measurable for target set, offset, width, root identity, provenance, completeness, and proof identity? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are downstream-consumer requirements defined for both the improved positive case and its paired conservative negative case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification require the minimal counterexample to fail before production implementation and identify the expected baseline failure state? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 1; Plan §Minimal Failing Case]

## Conservative Failure and False-Certainty Prevention

- [x] CHK005 Are MayAlias, unknown alias, unknown clobber, incomplete call, partial coverage, width/endian mismatch, volatile/atomic uncertainty, and incompatible provenance all explicitly prohibited from publishing precise targets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Are stale, truncated, cancelled, resource-limited, malformed, unsupported, and non-converged scenarios assigned explicit conservative outcomes rather than a generic success/failure result? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 Are false NoAlias, false MustAlias, false exact indirect target, stale publication, and semantic mismatch expressed as zero-tolerance measurable release criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK008 Are multiple-store, memory-phi, loop-carried, partial reconstruction, and agreeing-but-incomplete definitions either precisely specified or explicitly excluded from this increment? [Boundary, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Completeness and Failure Semantics]

## Identity, Provenance, and Invalidation

- [x] CHK009 Are snapshot, function, Semantic IR contract, MemorySSA build, source node, use/definition, access metadata, and proof identities all defined as freshness dependencies? [Completeness, Plan §Invalidation and Identity]
- [x] CHK010 Is the stale-binding refusal criterion objective across snapshot, function, semantic version, invalidated dependency, and source-entity mismatch? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Invalidation and Identity]
- [x] CHK011 Are provenance compatibility and root-identity requirements specified without permitting name-, string-, confidence-, rendered-output-, or target-specific inference? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Are cache invalidation and atomic-publication requirements consistent with the rule that failed, cancelled, or truncated refinement leaves the baseline result authoritative? [Consistency, Plan §Completeness and Failure Semantics; §Invalidation and Identity]

## Malformed, Cancellation, and Resource Boundaries

- [x] CHK013 Are malformed zero-width, non-integer, oversized, mixed-endian, and structurally invalid access-metadata outcomes explicitly defined? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are cancellation checkpoints, deterministic work/state bounds, and the no-partial-publication result specified objectively enough to derive tests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-006; Plan §Performance, Cancellation, and Budgets]
- [x] CHK015 Are the retained limits and asymptotic expectations quantified, including iteration, value, target, indexing, and per-load lookup bounds? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context; §Performance, Cancellation, and Budgets]
- [x] CHK016 Are browser and iOS/iPadOS fast-path constraints documented consistently with the prohibition on new workers, solvers, runtime dependencies, or architecture-specific paths? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context; §Performance, Cancellation, and Budgets]

## Determinism, Compatibility, and Test Integrity

- [x] CHK017 Are deterministic replay requirements measurable across results, diagnostics, completeness, and proof identity for identical inputs and analysis identities? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK018 Are architecture-neutral fixture and regression requirements defined without relying on a target-specific implementation detail? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010–FR-011]
- [x] CHK019 Are existing-denominator preservation, assertion-strength preservation, and additive regression requirements stated as auditable zero-removal/zero-weakening criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK020 Are positive, negative, boundary, malformed, cancellation, budget, stale-identity, deterministic-replay, and downstream scenario classes all required? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Ownership, Dependencies, and Release Evidence

- [x] CHK021 Is canonical ownership unambiguous between MemorySSA reaching-definition truth, points-to publication, compatibility orchestration, and downstream consumers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001; Plan §Canonical Producer and Consumer Flow]
- [x] CHK022 Are the expected and forbidden file boundaries complete enough to prevent unrelated Issue-Agent work and private duplicate semantic engines? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012; Plan §Implementation Boundary]
- [x] CHK023 Are dependency assumptions and deferrals explicit, including completed provenance/lifecycle prerequisites and HEX-C2-01 ownership of multi-store byte reconstruction? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Dependency Graph]
- [x] CHK024 Are exact-head, candidate-merge-tree, generated-artifact, CI, expected-head merge, and post-merge live-main requirements all bound to one auditable product identity? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008; Plan §T3]
- [x] CHK025 Is concurrent Issue-Agent overlap required to be rechecked against the actual final inventory before merge, with collision producing a blocked state rather than duplicate implementation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012; Plan §Current-Main Evidence]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.

- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
